# msgraph-entra_directory_role_eligible_assignment (Resource)

Manages an eligible assignment for an Entra ID directory role using Privileged Identity Management (PIM). This resource creates time-bound eligible role assignments that users must activate to use. Updates to justification and schedule_info are performed in-place using the adminUpdate action, avoiding disruption to user access. Changes to role_definition_id, principal_id, or directory_scope_id require replacement.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `principal_id` (String) The object ID of the principal (user, group, or service principal) to assign the eligible role to.
- `role_definition_id` (String) The ID of the directory role definition (template ID). Example: '62e90394-69f5-4237-9190-012177145e10' for Global Administrator.

### Optional

- `directory_scope_id` (String) The scope of the role assignment. Use '/' for tenant-wide scope.
- `justification` (String) Justification for the role assignment.
- `schedule_info` (Block, Optional) The schedule of the role eligibility. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--schedule_info))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the role eligibility schedule request.
- `schedule_id` (String) The ID of the created role eligibility schedule.

<a id="nestedblock--schedule_info"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule_info`

Optional:

- `expiration` (Block, Optional) When and how the eligibility expires. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--schedule_info--expiration))
- `start_date_time` (String) When the eligibility starts. Must be in RFC3339 format (e.g., '2025-01-08T00:00:00Z'). Defaults to now.

<a id="nestedblock--schedule_info--expiration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule_info.expiration`

Optional:

- `duration` (String) The duration when type is 'afterDuration'. Use ISO 8601 duration format (e.g., 'PT8H' for 8 hours, 'P365D' for 365 days).
- `end_date_time` (String) The end date/time when type is 'afterDateTime'. Must be in RFC3339 format.
- `type` (String) The type of expiration: 'noExpiration', 'afterDateTime', or 'afterDuration'.
